candidates.title: File:Gurez Valley 04.jpg
candidates.author: Journo Mohsin
candidates.description: Gurez Valley in North Kashmir's Bandipora district, like all other valleys in Kashmir, is picture-perfect throughout the year. After more than seven decades the valley is now open to tourists. Nemophilists from different corners of the country throng the valley, to enjoy the beauty there.
